events.title: Noble Investment Group acquires 10-property upscale select-service, extended stay portfolio
events.body: The deal, including Marriott, Hilton and IHG hotels, furthers Noble’s investment in the high-demand and durable categories.

events.title: Driftwood Hospitality Management appoints new CEO
events.body: The hotel management company tapped former Playa Hotels & Resorts Chief Operating Officer Gregory Maliassas to lead its next phase of growth as it eyes expansion across the Americas.
